flags: No trust center or dedicated security page; security/compliance info scattered across privacy policy and terms only.
No major IT security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) published. Unusual for a fintech platform with customer financial data.
Privacy policy does not explicitly state whether customer prompts, portfolio data, or trading signals are used to train InvestGPT or other ML models. This is a material gap for an AI-driven product.
Data residency: EU data can be transferred outside EU. No explicit regional data center options for compliance-sensitive use cases.

The kavout.com platform does not claim SEC/RIA registration on its own site and disclaims giving investment advice. An SEC RIA registration exists only under a separate legal entity (Kavout Algo Financial LLC); it is a financial-regulation status for a distinct advisory firm, not an information-security certification for this platform.
Service provided 'as is' with limited liability; standard for consumer fintech but notable liability cap of $50 USD.
No explicit mention of penetration testing, security audits, or third-party security assessments.
